name: カード番号と有効期限・確認番号を指定する入力欄
prompt:
Create one faithful Japanese-localized credit card form based on the supplied references. The original crop controls the layout and field geometry; the Japanese preview controls exact labels, placeholders, and the small green 「カード」 indicator. Render only the form on a white canvas at roughly 559×176 proportions (about 3.17:1), with no broad margins, extra dialog, or footer.

At the top, place the label 「カード番号」 above a full-width, lightly bordered rounded input. Inside the input, left-align the supplied sample placeholder 「1234 1234 1234 1234」 in muted gray, and right-align the small green label 「カード」. Treat the number strictly as the reference's placeholder example, not as personal or payment data. Below it, make one two-column row with equal-width inputs and the same subtle border and corner radius: left label 「有効期限」 with placeholder 「月 / 年」; right label 「確認番号」 with placeholder 「3桁の番号」. Keep label spacing, input heights, horizontal gap, and padding close to the original screenshot. Use a restrained Japanese sans-serif UI style with crisp readable text, neutral gray labels and borders, and no additional icons or text.
